feature: Workbook-backed Prime Contract creation through AI chat

flows.name: Positive workbook-backed create
steps: Attach a canonical Alleato estimate workbook
Review exact mapped SOV rows and planned writes
Request and explicitly grant signed approval
Reload the receipt and open the canonical Prime Contract
flows.expectedOutcome: Exactly one Prime Contract and two budget-code-linked SOV rows persist with the workbook total

checks: Workbook source, rows, totals, and unapplied markups are readable
Created receipt links to the canonical detail route

claims.description: The mapped workbook draft is captured before approval
The exact signed approval state is captured
The created receipt and canonical route are captured
Contract fields, SOV rows, totals, and budget-code links are verified
Conversation reload preserves the created receipt
Invalid runtime configuration fails loudly before a write
Mobile visual review and overflow checks are complete
Canonical parser, tool, approval, and chat seams pass regression tests
The approval secret is configured in every Vercel target
